meta.name: Portfolio Snapshot + One Pager dependency map (verified content)
meta.verification: Sources, blast radius, constants and divergences verified against live code on 2026-09-24.
meta.answer_rule: Report only from these fields. Give the blast radius, the duplicates to keep in sync, and the consumer count. Never invent a consumer or a downstream field.

sources.name: ISBS — Interim BS debt accounts 2150 / 2152 / 2210
sources.provides: Outstanding debt balance: abs(sum(mAmount)) over 2150/2152/2210 at latest period <= quarter-end.
sources.blast_radius_note: Changing DEBT_BS_ACCTS moves cap stacks, Total Cap, LTV, Debt Yield, DSCR principal, dashboard debt and NAV split at once. A SECOND hardcoded copy at one_pager.py:1110 must change too or One Pager DSCR principal diverges.
sources.traps: Stale-debt guard returns 0.0 (paid off) when latest debt period < BS period and no loan row; returns None (not 0) when no ISBS at all.

sources.name: ISBS — Income statement (Interim IS / Projected IS / Budget IS)
sources.provides: Revenue & expense accounts by period (actual / budget / projected).
sources.blast_radius_note: TWO IS_ACCOUNTS dicts: config.py:251 vs one_pager.py:1077. One Pager omits 4075 & 5092, keeps 7070 out of Real Estate Taxes (separate), Principal=['7060'] where config=[]. Editing config moves Property Financials / Surveillance / Dashboard / snapshot Debt Yield NOI but NOT One Pager revenue/expenses/NOI. Edit both together.
sources.traps: One Pager NOI uses one_pager.IS_ACCOUNTS, not config.IS_ACCOUNTS — any 'IS_ACCOUNTS' citation must name which set.

sources.name: accounting_feed.Amt (contributions / commitments / distributions)
sources.provides: Every investor's cash in (contribution/commitment) and cash out (distribution).
sources.blast_radius_note: Feeds the entire equity side. Sign convention is central: negative = cash IN (contribution), positive = cash OUT (distribution).
sources.traps: cap_stack netting uses capital_after (signed) while compute.get_deal_capitalization uses abs(amt) — they diverge on reversal rows (~$80.5M, 66 rows, 16 deals). return_of_capital includes 'realized gain' rows but cap-stack netting does NOT — this is why funded − ROC mis-states current_pe_balance.

sources.name: MRI_Loans.mOrigLoanAmt (committed facility)
sources.provides: Original committed loan amount per deal.
sources.blast_radius_note: Drives debt whenever ISBS returns None (incl. parent inheriting co-terminous child loans) and every loan calculation.
sources.traps: Matched case-insensitively on mOrigLoanAmt AND mOriginLoanAmt.

sources.name: MRI_Loans [terms] (nRate, vIntType, vIndex, vSpread, dtMaturity, ...)
sources.provides: Each loan's rate, index, spread, floor, maturity, amortization, structure.
sources.blast_radius_note: Feeds rate/maturity display and every schedule.
sources.traps: Floating (vIntType in FLOATING_INT_TYPES + vIndex + vSpread) renders 'index + bps' and BEATS nRate. Paid-off loans dropped from mri_loans_raw, kept in mri_loans_all (payoff-month substitution).

sources.name: MRI_Occupancy_Download (Occ% / OccupancyPercent)
sources.provides: Physical occupancy readings per property over time.
sources.blast_radius_note: Econ Occ = occupancy MINUS bad-debt % (Interim IS 4040+4043 over 4010) — NOT a pure occupancy field.
sources.traps: dtReported parsed format='mixed'; >50% NaT -> retried as Excel serial (origin 1899-12-30).

sources.name: Prop_Info_AtClose (at_close_revenue / _expenses / _noi / _interest / _principal)
sources.provides: Revenue, expenses and NOI underwritten at acquisition.
sources.blast_radius_note: The acquisition baseline the growth metrics compare against.
sources.traps: Year-0 gate zeroes a dev deal (or P0000066) with no 2015-12-31 Projected IS row — both required or 9 non-dev deals wrongly zero. Fallback nets 7083 (30 Bearfoot only). Many deals carry a 2015-12-31 date (upstream defect).

sources.name: MRI_Budget_Econ_Occ (YTDAvgPctOccupied, PctOccupied)
sources.blast_radius_note: Projects occupancy for the rest of the year.
sources.traps: Stored as DECIMAL (0.887) ×100 to match Occ%. Budget bad-debt leg ADDS account 4041 which the actual leg omits (asymmetric, deliberate). Q4 / no budget -> ytd_actual.

sources.name: Prop_Info_DealTerms (econ_occ_at_close, pe coupon, pe participation, irr_lookback)
sources.provides: PE coupon & participation, occupancy at close, IRR lookback.
sources.blast_radius_note: _pe_terms_fallback and _enrich_cap_stack_from_deal_terms read the SAME two columns with the same '<1' normalisation — change one and the Capitalization block and PE block print different numbers.
sources.traps: irr_lookback and econ_occ_at_close are written onto cap_stack but rendered nowhere (dead payload).

sources.name: MRI_VAL.mIncomeCapConcludedValue (via valuations)
sources.loads_to: download-only (target_table = null); app publishes via valuation_nav_service
sources.provides: Most recent concluded property value; also mPurchasePrice / Acquisition_Price.
sources.blast_radius_note: Download-only since Aug 2026 — the app is system of record; a refresh can NEVER overwrite app-published valuations, so every LTV depends on that.
sources.traps: dtValuation MUST be parsed format='mixed' or app-published rows silently NaT out.

known_divergences.where: one_pager.py:949 (capital_after) vs compute.py:298 (abs by row type)
known_divergences.effect: Reversal rows move capital twice in the compute path.
One Pager NOI vs Property Financials / Dashboard / snapshot Debt Yield NOI on different account bases (4075, 5092, 7070).
A config.DEBT_BS_ACCTS change does not reach One Pager DSCR principal.

known_divergences.what: return_of_capital includes realized gain; cap-stack netting does not
known_divergences.effect: funded_to_date − return_of_capital mis-states current_pe_balance (the engine uses seed_states instead).

known_defects.effect: The Vue recomputes variance client-side from ytd_actual/ytd_budget and never reads the backend key. Two implementations of one number.
Defaults to 0.0 where its two sibling exposure fields default to None — an unavailable yield prints as 0.0%.
irr_lookback and econ_occ_at_close (cap_stack) are computed and returned but rendered nowhere.
